candidate.claim: LRUCache.set deletes an existing key but never re-inserts it, so updating a cached key loses the entry and a subsequent get returns undefined.
candidate.title: LRUCache.set drops update for existing key

verifier.reason: The code at internal/lrucache.js:26 deletes the existing key and the re-insertion at internal/lrucache.js:35 is guarded by !deleted at internal/lrucache.js:28, so updating an existing key removes it without re-inserting and get at internal/lrucache.js:10-12 returns undefined.

candidate.claim: When cloning a SemVer instance with different loose/includePrerelease options the code re-parses version.version which excludes build metadata, so build identifiers are silently lost.
candidate.title: SemVer re-parse from SemVer loses build metadata

verifier.reason: The constructor at classes/semver.js:34 reassigns version to version.version when options differ, then re-parses that string at classes/semver.js:53 and derives build only from regex group m[5] at classes/semver.js:93, so a SemVer whose version string excludes build metadata loses its build identifiers.
